description: Keeps every pinned input current, one pull request at a time (README, "Pipeline"). Its branches (renovate/...) bump the patch version. They merge on their own once their checks pass (through the merge queue); releases are batched daily (version.yml).

packageRules.description: Minor, patch and digest updates together; a major version gets a pull request of its own.

A new Zig changes the language: its own pull request, and its checksums (install-zig.sh, the Dockerfile) are updated by hand from ziglang.org's index.json, which CI enforces by failing until they are.

A new Lean: its own pull request. proofs/lean-toolchain and install-lean.sh move together, and install-lean.sh's checksums are updated by hand from the release's assets, which CI enforces by failing until they are.

tls.zig, pinned by commit in runner/build.zig.zon's URL: its own pull request for each new commit on its main branch (commits have no release dates, so no week's wait). The zon's .hash must follow, which Renovate cannot compute: it is updated by hand (`zig fetch` the new URL), which CI enforces by failing until it is (zig-modules.sh compares it with the fetched commit's, as `zig build` does), as for Zig's checksums.

GitHub's expression test cases (actions/languageservices), pinned by commit in expr-conformance.sh: their own pull request (commits have no release dates, so no week's wait). A case the runner newly fails, or a listed one it now passes, fails CI until runner/tools/exprcorpus-failing.txt is updated (`expr-conformance.sh --update`, after a look at what changed).

The diff tools' references run what GitHub's runner runs, so a new major is a different reference, not an update: .NET 8 (problem matchers are compiled by .NET 8's Regex, regex-diff.sh) and Node 22 (hashFiles' @actions/glob script, hashfiles-diff.sh). Minor and digest updates within them still come. Raise the major by hand when GitHub's runner does.

The Dagger engine moves with the runner, by hand: the runner speaks exactly one engine version's protocol (runner/src/engine.zig, client_version), and a new engine starts with an empty cache. So no update is proposed for it, let alone merged; deploy/compose.yaml says the same.

busybox, the helper image the runner puts into job containers (runner/src/dagger.zig): a new version changes the applets every Docker action, service forwarder and output-key store runs on (sh, tcpsvd, nc, mv -T, cp -a, ...), so it gets its own pull request, which busybox-pin.sh gates; and every update re-keys those steps, which run once more after it.
The official busybox image is rebuilt, and its tag re-pushed, about monthly, each time a digest update that re-runs the steps above: proposed monthly at most.
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: ubuntu, the default job image (runner/src/dagger.zig) and the shared base of every job: a digest update re-keys every step, which runs once more after it, so it gets its own pull request, which ubuntu-pin.sh gates, proposed monthly at most. A new release (24.04 to 26.04) changes what provisioning installs and is moved by hand, so none is proposed.
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Only the digest of the pinned ubuntu tag moves (see above).

customManagers.description: Zig: install-zig.sh and the Dockerfile (versions are tags of ziglang/zig).

changie, pinned by version in install-changie.sh. A new version also needs its checksum from the release's checksums.txt, updated by hand, which CI enforces by failing until it is (the Workflows job runs install-changie.sh).

checksec, pinned by version in checksec.sh. A new version also needs its checksums from the release's checksec_checksums.sha512, updated by hand, which CI enforces by failing until they are (Release builds runs checksec.sh on a change to it).
The images release.yml pins by digest: Trivy, BuildKit and BuildKit's SBOM scanner.
Lean: install-lean.sh and proofs/lean-toolchain (versions are releases of leanprover/lean4).
Images the scripts run, pinned by digest (shellcheck, and the reference implementations the diff tools compare with).

busybox, the helper image the runner names in Zig source (runner/src/dagger.zig), pinned by its multi-arch index digest; the literal is split over two lines with ++, and CI's busybox-pin.sh checks the pin, failing on a shape this pattern would miss.

ubuntu, the default job image the runner names in Zig source (runner/src/dagger.zig), pinned by its multi-arch index digest; the literal is split over two lines with ++, and CI's ubuntu-pin.sh checks the pin, failing on a shape this pattern would miss.
actionlint, run by version from Go in CI and the hooks.
zizmor, run by version from PyPI in CI and the pre-push hook.
tls.zig, the runner's one Zig dependency: the commit its GitHub archive URL names in runner/build.zig.zon, followed on its main branch.
GitHub's expression test cases: LANGUAGESERVICES_REV in expr-conformance.sh, followed on actions/languageservices' main branch.
